messages:
Cheng Li: Heads-up — noticed a ~25% p90 token decode latency regression on /chat-stream over the last 6 hours. Per-route KPI shows median stable but tail popped. Heatmap suggests kernel selection changed at ~14:03.
Maria G: Is this only for medium sequences (~128-256 tokens)?
Cheng Li: Yeah, primarily 150-220 tokens. Packing heuristics seem to push mixed batches that trigger the fall-back kernel (kernel_v3_fused) instead of kernel_v2_fast. See perf dashboard: https://console.redwood/perf/routes/chat-stream
Alex K: Any KV hit-rate change? If we see more cold sessions, KV misses could increase upstream latency.
Cheng Li: KV miss rate jumped from 6% -> 18% for that route in the same window.
trace-bot: Trace pinned: https://traces.redwood/internal/trace/abc123 (sample request id: req=tx_1967804)
Samira: Can you paste an example trace/span? We should tag spans with selected_kernel and batch_size so dashboards can link easily.
Cheng Li: Attached short span excerpt:
```
span:decode.start kernel=kernel_v3_fused batch=16 seq=180 kv_hit=false duration_ms=12.4
span:kv.lookup hit=false duration_ms=0.8
span:decode.end duration_ms=12.1
```
Maria G: Hmm kernel_v3_fused latency is higher for those SOS lengths. Maybe our kernel selector uses avg-seq instead of max-seq — mixed packing causes fallback. Suggested quick fix: bias selector to prefer kernels that handle high-max-seq in mixed batches.
Alex K: We should also expose token-level breakdown on the per-request view and add a jump link from the KPI row to the trace. That will make triage much faster.
Cheng Li: Agreed. Action items: (1) runtime: add selected_kernel and batch_max_seq as span attributes (Alex). (2) infra: add per-request token-latency waterfall to console and link to traces (Samira). (3) ops: run a targeted canary with packing tweak (Maria).
Alex K: I'll open a PR to instrument spans, simple change. Also will add a short query to fetch traces: `service:runtime AND attrs.request_id:req=tx_* AND attrs.selected_kernel:*`.
Samira: I'll wire a console widget and add a trace-link button. Can we include KV-hit boolean per-request? Might be heavy per-token, but per-request kv_hit_rate is doable.
Cheng Li: For triage, I attached 3 trace IDs: req=tx_1967804, req=tx_1967840, req=tx_1967899. Please correlate with tokens 120-210.
Alex K: thx, starting now. :thumbsup: 
Maria G: Nice catch. Let's sync at 15:30 if we need rollout.
Cheng Li: Thanks team.
